clusters.headline: MPR Sets Schedule To Select New Indonesian Vice President Candidate
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia is scheduling a plenary session to finalize the selection of a new vice president.
President Prabowo Subianto is required to submit two potential candidates to the parliament within a 14-day window following the vacancy.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Investigate Alleged Wiretapping Of President Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto stated that former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit and three other generals allegedly ordered the illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto.
A high-ranking active officer identified by the initials TK is currently being questioned by the internal affairs division regarding his involvement.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Accepts Vice President Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto has officially accepted the resignation of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
The Vice President stated his decision was motivated by personal educational plans, explicitly denying links to previous diploma controversies.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Customs Officials Sentenced In Bribery And Graft Case
aiSummaryBullets: Three former Directorate General of Customs and Excise officials received prison sentences between six and nine years.
The convictions stem from bribery and gratuities linked to the importation of imitation goods involving PT BlueRay Cargo.

clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police Confirm Authenticity Of Jokowi Diploma
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police stated that the academic certificate of former President Joko Widodo has been forensically verified.
The Police Laboratory and Forensics Center conducted the examination according to established legal and procedural standards.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially submitted his resignation letter to the People's Consultative Assembly.
President Prabowo Subianto has acknowledged the resignation, while political factions have offered contrasting interpretations of the decision.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Maintain Subsidy Stability Amid Fuel Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto stated that fuel subsidies remain secure until the end of 2026.
Authorities identified increased consumption of subsidized Pertalite and Solar fuels, rising by 13 percent and 14 percent respectively.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Administrative Court Dismisses Lawsuit Regarding Gibran Degree
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta Administrative Court declared the lawsuit concerning Gibran Rakabuming Raka's educational equivalency certificate as dismissed following its revocation by the Ministry.
Legal representatives for Gibran Rakabuming Raka criticized the ruling as lacking objectivity and stated their intent to pursue further legal avenues.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Steps Down From Nvidia Amid Spying And Affair Reports
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has officially resigned from his roles as CEO, president, and board member of the semiconductor firm Nvidia.
The resignation follows public allegations concerning an extramarital affair with an individual suspected of involvement in espionage.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Indonesian Vice Presidency Role
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his post as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The outgoing official met with President Prabowo Subianto at the Presidential Palace to finalize his departure.
